env_allowlist.HOME: runner account used only to locate the already installed pinned Lean toolchain

network_enforcement: The checker performs only repository-local reconciliation and invokes the pinned Lean binary directly against existing read-only dependency outputs. It makes no network request and performs no Lake resolution, update, build, clone, fetch, checkout, or .lake mutation.

expected_outputs.semantic_hash_policy: exact deterministic five-line negative release summary

scope_boundary: Validates the exact blocked release verdict and rechecks the unchanged exact root in a temporary output tree at trust zero. It is not immutable clean input, an empty-cache cold build, offline restoration, an accepted foundation/TCB/SBOM closure, distinct signed verification, an independent minimal verifier, a deterministic release bundle, theorem completion, or master acceptance.
